sourceTitle: Equipping healthcare professionals with practical AI skills
originalTitle: Equipping healthcare professionals with practical AI skills
author: Dr. Michael Howell

blocks.text: As I’ve traveled around the world this year, I’ve heard loud and clear from healthcare professionals how much need there is for a thoughtful but practical educational resource on AI, made specifically for healthcare. Today, we're announcing the Google AI for Healthcare Professionals Certificate, a new program designed to teach responsible, practical ways to use AI in day-to-day work. Built to fit busy schedules, the program offers flexible, self-paced lessons that focus on non-clinical administrative tasks. It is designed to be completed in less than five hours and to keep patients’ safety and privacy front and center.
blocks.zh: 当我今年环游世界时,我从医护专业人士那里听到的很响亮,专为保健而设。今天,我们...我们正在宣布Google AI的保健专业人员证书,一个新的方案,旨在教导负责任的,在日常工作中使用AI的实用方法.为了适应繁忙的日程安排方案提供灵活的,注重非临床行政任务的自定进度课程。它设计在不到5小时的时间内完成,并保持患者的安全和隐私的前沿和中心.
blocks.en: As I’ve traveled around the world this year, I’ve heard loud and clear from healthcare professionals how much need there is for a thoughtful but practical educational resource on AI, made specifically for healthcare. Today, we're announcing the Google AI for Healthcare Professionals Certificate, a new program designed to teach responsible, practical ways to use AI in day-to-day work. Built to fit busy schedules, the program offers flexible, self-paced lessons that focus on non-clinical administrative tasks. It is designed to be completed in less than five hours and to keep patients’ safety and privacy front and center.

blocks.text: Having spent my career in medicine, I know that people in healthcare are driven by a shared purpose to care for others, support families, and make a meaningful difference in their communities. Technology offers a real opportunity to support that purpose. Across disciplines, care teams are navigating how AI can shoulder administrative tasks and create more time for what matters most: patients.
blocks.zh: 在医学领域度过了一生我知道在医疗领域的人 被一个共同的目标驱使 照顾他人,支助家庭;并给他们的社区带来有意义的变化。技术提供了支持这一目的的真正机会。跨学科,护理团队正在探索AI如何承担行政任务,为最重要的事情创造更多的时间:病人们。
blocks.en: Having spent my career in medicine, I know that people in healthcare are driven by a shared purpose to care for others, support families, and make a meaningful difference in their communities. Technology offers a real opportunity to support that purpose. Across disciplines, care teams are navigating how AI can shoulder administrative tasks and create more time for what matters most: patients.

blocks.text: Reclaiming that time has never been more urgent. A National Nursing Workforce Survey found that nearly one in three registered nurses planned to leave or retire due to unsustainable workloads. Emerging technologies are poised to ease these pressures, but nine out of 10 doctors say they want dedicated training in how to use AI effectively. Regardless of your role in healthcare, navigating AI tools shouldn’t be something you have to figure out on your own. The Google AI for Healthcare Professionals Certificate offers an opportunity to build these skills, while earning up to 5.0 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits™.
blocks.zh: 恢复这一时间从未象现在这样紧迫。全国护理工作人员调查发现,近三分之一的注册护士由于无法持续的工作量而计划离职或退休。新兴技术已准备好缓解这些压力,但每10名医生中就有9名医生说他们想接受如何有效利用AI的专门培训.不管你在医疗方面的角色浏览人工智能工具不应该是你自己想出来的。Google保健专业人员AI证书提供了一个培养这些技能的机会,收入最高为5.0AMA PRA第1类信贷。
blocks.en: Reclaiming that time has never been more urgent. A National Nursing Workforce Survey found that nearly one in three registered nurses planned to leave or retire due to unsustainable workloads. Emerging technologies are poised to ease these pressures, but nine out of 10 doctors say they want dedicated training in how to use AI effectively. Regardless of your role in healthcare, navigating AI tools shouldn’t be something you have to figure out on your own. The Google AI for Healthcare Professionals Certificate offers an opportunity to build these skills, while earning up to 5.0 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits™.

blocks.text: Healthcare organizations are already putting the training into practice. NYU Grossman School of Medicine, University of Alabama at Birmingham, and Touro University are offering it to their faculty, residents, and medical students. Additionally, leading nursing institutions, including Purdue University School of Nursing, are offering the certificate as part of their healthcare professional training.
blocks.zh: 保健组织已经在实施培训。纽约大学格罗斯曼医学院,阿拉巴马大学伯明翰分校而图罗大学正提供 给他们的教职员工,居民,和医科学生。此外,主要的护理机构,包括Purdue大学护理学院,正在提供该证书,作为其保健专业培训的一部分。
blocks.en: Healthcare organizations are already putting the training into practice. NYU Grossman School of Medicine, University of Alabama at Birmingham, and Touro University are offering it to their faculty, residents, and medical students. Additionally, leading nursing institutions, including Purdue University School of Nursing, are offering the certificate as part of their healthcare professional training.

blocks.text: Clinical and medical education professionals who reviewed the curriculum also emphasize the importance of practical AI literacy.
blocks.zh: 审查课程的临床和医学教育专业人员也强调实用AI识字的重要性。
blocks.en: Clinical and medical education professionals who reviewed the curriculum also emphasize the importance of practical AI literacy.

blocks.text: Built by healthcare professionals for healthcare professionals
blocks.zh: 由保健专业人员为保健专业人员建造
blocks.en: Built by healthcare professionals for healthcare professionals

blocks.text: Developed by clinicians at Google — with backgrounds spanning internal medicine, pediatrics, critical care medicine, emergency medicine, and public health — the curriculum draws on draft versions of the Association of American Medical Colleges (AAMC) Artificial Intelligence Competencies Across the Learning Curriculum (which was under development at the time of the initial course design, but reflected the overall direction of the final competencies).
blocks.zh: 由Google的临床医生开发,背景包括内科,儿科医生,关键护理药物;急诊,——课程借鉴了美国医学院协会(AAMC)在学习全过程中人工智能能力的草稿。课程(在初步课程设计时正在编写)但反映了最终能力的总体方向)。
blocks.en: Developed by clinicians at Google — with backgrounds spanning internal medicine, pediatrics, critical care medicine, emergency medicine, and public health — the curriculum draws on draft versions of the Association of American Medical Colleges (AAMC) Artificial Intelligence Competencies Across the Learning Curriculum (which was under development at the time of the initial course design, but reflected the overall direction of the final competencies).

blocks.text: Across four courses, learners will explore high-impact ways to integrate AI into their daily routines.
blocks.zh: 通过四个课程,学习者将探索高影响的方法,将AI融入日常活动.
blocks.en: Across four courses, learners will explore high-impact ways to integrate AI into their daily routines.

blocks.text: Build foundational skills: Spot practical ways to use AI and confidently evaluate outputs, keeping clinical judgement, safety, and privacy at the forefront.
blocks.zh: 培养基础技能:点点实用的方法来使用人工智能和自信地评价产出,保持临床判断,保证安全,和隐私摆在首位。
blocks.en: Build foundational skills: Spot practical ways to use AI and confidently evaluate outputs, keeping clinical judgement, safety, and privacy at the forefront.

blocks.text: Strengthen patient communication: Translate complex medical concepts into clear, patient-friendly audio and visual guides, helping patients better understand and manage their care.
blocks.zh: 加强患者沟通:将复杂的医学概念转化为明确的,方便病人的视听指南,帮助病人更好地了解和管理他们的护理。
blocks.en: Strengthen patient communication: Translate complex medical concepts into clear, patient-friendly audio and visual guides, helping patients better understand and manage their care.

blocks.text: Optimize day-to-day administrative tasks: Streamline non-clinical work — like scheduling or reviewing dense email threads — and use natural language to build helpful tools without coding.
blocks.zh: 优化日常行政任务:简化非临床工作——如排程或审查稠密的电子邮件线程——并使用自然语言构建无编码的有用工具.
blocks.en: Optimize day-to-day administrative tasks: Streamline non-clinical work — like scheduling or reviewing dense email threads — and use natural language to build helpful tools without coding.

blocks.text: Accelerate lifelong learning: Digest complex clinical studies, organize presentations, and sharpen preparation for exams and certifications.
blocks.zh: 加快终生学习:文摘综合临床研究组织发言,并强化考试和认证的准备工作。
blocks.en: Accelerate lifelong learning: Digest complex clinical studies, organize presentations, and sharpen preparation for exams and certifications.

blocks.text: Designed to give time back to patient care
blocks.zh: 设计为让时间回到病人护理
blocks.en: Designed to give time back to patient care

blocks.text: Continuing education is non-negotiable in healthcare, and this course is one step in supporting AI education for healthcare professionals. By streamlining the routine tasks that pull you away from the bedside, our goal is simple: to give you back the time, the focus, and the joy of caring for your patients.
blocks.zh: 继续教育在保健方面是不容谈判的;这个课程是支持保健专业人员AI教育的一个步骤。通过精简常规任务 让你远离床边,我们的目标很简单:给你回时间,重点,以及照顾你的病人的喜悦
blocks.en: Continuing education is non-negotiable in healthcare, and this course is one step in supporting AI education for healthcare professionals. By streamlining the routine tasks that pull you away from the bedside, our goal is simple: to give you back the time, the focus, and the joy of caring for your patients.

blocks.text: Learn more and register today at grow.google/healthcare.
blocks.zh: 今天在grow.google/保健上学习更多的知识并注册。
blocks.en: Learn more and register today at grow.google/healthcare.
